summary: Apple's Automator is a workflow engine that runs ordered action bundles and shell or AppleScript actions, with a workflow view and controller. BifrOSt now has a pure workflow model (ordered steps, output passed to the next step, run, step, resume, stop and reset) and script I/O framing, but no action bundles, no shell runtime and no app that runs workflows. Shortcuts still runs nothing: its actions are only logged because the shell cannot receive them over the app protocol.

features.note: Apps declare typed intents in code and manifest.toml [[intent]] tables and serve them over the control socket. There is no bundle format, no install location scan (the reference lists /System/Library/Automator, /Library/Automator and ~/Library/Automator) and no view for action parameters.

ScriptIo models the input and output field separators and carriage-return remapping. Nothing starts a shell, Perl or Python process, and no workflow step uses ScriptIo yet. The defaults (newline separators, no remapping) are BifrOSt choices, because the reference does not state them.

features.apple: AMWorkflow (actions, addAction, insertAction, moveAction, removeAction, input, output, valueForVariable)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/workflow.rs (Workflow, Step); springboard/apps/shortcuts-desktop/src/model.rs (Shortcut { name, color, actions }, Action enum)
features.note: Workflow keeps ordered steps with enabled flags and needs_input, passes each step's output to the next step, and keeps per-step results and the workflow output. There are no variables and no valueForVariable. Shortcuts still uses its own model and does not build a Workflow.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/workflow.rs (WorkflowController: run, step, resume, stop, reset, can_run, state); springboard/apps/shortcuts-desktop/src/widget.rs:365 (run_all, which only queues actions)
features.note: The controller runs all steps, runs one step at a time (leaving the run Paused), resumes, stops a paused run and resets. Execution is synchronous, so there is no isRunning and no delegate. The Shortcuts app does not call the controller yet, and no run-by-path API exists.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/shortcuts-desktop/src/widget.rs (View::Editor, the Add Action list driven by model.rs KINDS)
features.note: The editor adds, removes and reorders built-in actions. It cannot edit action parameters through a generic view and cannot be embedded by other apps.

features.apple: AMAction offering actions to workflows; Shortcuts listing actions from installed apps
features.note: The shell lists shortcut = true intents in Spotlight and runs parameterless ones. The Shortcuts app does not yet list or run intents from other apps (documented gap in docs/bifrost-ui.md around line 978).

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/workflow.rs (WorkflowError: NoEnabledSteps, InsufficientInput, StepFailed with the step index); springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (RpcError and failed())
features.note: A failed step stops the run and the error names the step. There is no error domain and no code table (the reference lists about 40 codes), and no error key that names the action in the error.
Apple marks this class deprecated and it depends on OSA scripting. BifrOSt has no AppleScript runtime and does not plan one.

gaps: No script runtime: ScriptIo frames the text, but nothing starts a shell, Perl or Python process for a workflow step.

Workflows do not run Shortcuts actions: the Shortcuts app still logs Wi-Fi, Low Power, Do Not Disturb, brightness, open app, screenshot and timer actions instead of executing them (springboard/apps/shortcuts-desktop/src/main.rs).
No variables or named values between steps (valueForVariable); only the previous output is passed on.
No action bundle format or install scan: no equivalent of /System/Library/Automator, /Library/Automator or ~/Library/Automator.
No workflow controller delegate, no isRunning, and no runWorkflow-by-path API or workflow file format.
Shortcuts does not list or run intents from other installed apps yet (docs/bifrost-ui.md, App Intents gaps).
No error code table for workflow failures; only three error cases exist.
